description: This file defines the 'DB' class in the Goteo project, extending the PDO class to manage database connections, including features such as cache management, read replica handling, and query statistics. It encapsulates database initialization and configuration, including handling the main database and optional replica servers, with methods for preparing SQL statements and toggling cache and replica usage.

classes.name: DB
classes.description: A class extending PDO to manage database connections with support for cache, read replicas, and query statistics specifically for the Goteo project.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the database connection, including optional setup for read replicas and cache.

methods.name: cleanCache
methods.description: Clears the cache if it is enabled.

methods.name: prepare
methods.description: Prepares an SQL statement, routing to the read replica if applicable and enabled.

methods.name: getQueryStats
methods.description: Returns statistics about executed queries, including cache hits and misses for both master and replica.

methods.name: cache
methods.description: Static method to enable or disable the internal SQL cache globally.

methods.name: replica
methods.description: Static method to enable or disable the use of read replicas globally.

search-terms: PDO extension with cache and replica management
